title: Review
$comment: v1.0. The owner's review queue (Phase 4, #115/#377; decisions D8, D11, D12 in docs/research/phase-4-decisions-alignment.md).

ReviewCategory.title: ReviewCategory
ReviewCategory.description: outdated: the workflow no longer works and nothing waits for review. heal_pending: an AI-chosen fix waits for the owner (D8). unstable: 2+ flaky validations in 7 days. cant_check: the last 3 validations were blocked (sign-in, CAPTCHA, site down, ...).

ReviewAction.title: ReviewAction
ReviewAction.description: accept / reject: POST /reviews/{id}/accept|reject (heal_pending only). regenerate: POST /workflows/{id}/regenerate. retry_ai_fix: POST /workflows/{id}/retry-ai-fix. retry_check: POST /workflows/{id}/reverify.

ReviewItem.title: ReviewItem
ReviewItem.description: One thing in the owner's review queue. Derived from the workflow, its versions and its validations; nothing is stored for the item itself.

id.description: Stable item id, `<category>:<uuid>`: the pending version's id for heal_pending, else the workflow's id.

reason.description: Short, plain words for the owner, e.g. 'Step 3: the "Create Repository" button is gone'.

step_seq.description: The step that failed, when one did.

since.description: When this started: the version's creation, or the validation that put it here.

pending_revision.description: heal_pending: the number of the version waiting for review.

step_diff.description: heal_pending: how the waiting version differs from the current one.

actions.description: What the owner can do with this item now (e.g. retry_ai_fix only while the daily AI budget lasts).

count.description: Number of items in the queue (the nav badge).

ReviewActionResult.title: ReviewActionResult
ReviewActionResult.description: After accept / reject: the workflow as it is now.
